findings.title: No timeout on oracle consensus rounds
findings.description: run_consensus calls async functions with no outer timeout. Leader crash or P2P hang blocks all oracles indefinitely.
findings.evidence: No tokio::time::timeout wrapping run_consensus. All downstream operations (price fetch, BLS sign, P2P broadcast) can hang.
findings.recommendation: Wrap run_consensus in tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(120)). Emit WARN at 60s.

findings.title: Bridge fund lock without TTL
findings.description: PendingLock has no expiry. reverseLock requires 15/20 threshold. Current testnet has 3 oracles.
findings.evidence: initiateBridge stores PendingLock with no lockExpiry field. reverseLock uses higher threshold than standard operations.
findings.recommendation: Add lockExpiry = block.timestamp + LOCK_TTL. Allow permissionless reversal after expiry.

findings.title: Two-phase commit atomicity risk — ITP backing invariant
findings.description: Settlement TX revert after bridge confirmation can cause unbacked share minting.
findings.evidence: completeBuyOrder on settlement and share mint on L3 are not atomic. No cryptographic proof of settlement completion required for mint.
findings.recommendation: Require settlement TX hash inclusion proof before L3 mint. Or implement challenge period for clawback.

findings.title: Silent error swallowing across frontend
findings.description: 16+ catch blocks with empty bodies. Operators have zero visibility into frontend errors.
findings.evidence: useBetsSSE.ts:291-293, useLeaderboardSSE.ts:225, useSimulation.ts:156, useDataNode.ts, useApBalances.ts, useItpFees.ts, useExplorerHealth.ts, useNonceCheck.ts
findings.recommendation: Replace empty catch blocks with logger.error() + graceful fallback rendering.

findings.title: No cross-chain balance reconciliation
findings.description: Total L3 locked vs Settlement released never compared. Divergence accumulates silently.
findings.evidence: No reconciliation function or keeper job exists. Balance drift from decimal conversion, failed rollbacks, or double-submissions undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add off-chain reconciliation job. On-chain view function exposing cumulative totals for monitoring.

findings.title: AP order timeout not enforced on-chain
findings.description: TimeoutHandler is in-memory. AP crash loses all tracked timeouts. No permissionless on-chain refund.
findings.evidence: TimeoutHandler uses HashMap in AP process. No on-chain deadline + grace period mechanism for permissionless refund.
findings.recommendation: Add permissionless claimExpiredOrder(orderId) callable after deadline + GRACE_PERIOD.

findings.title: RPC connection failure fatal at startup
findings.description: Provider creation fails without retry. Oracle never boots if RPC temporarily unreachable.
findings.evidence: Provider::<Http>::try_from(url) called once. Failure = fatal exit.
findings.recommendation: Retry with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, max 30s). Log each attempt.

findings.title: Share calculation truncates — 0 shares on small fills
findings.description: Integer division truncates shares to 0 for small fillAmount relative to high NAV. E037 revert.
findings.evidence: shares = (fillAmount * 1e18) / fillPrice. If fillAmount * 1e18 < fillPrice, shares = 0.
findings.recommendation: Document minimum effective order size per ITP. Frontend guard for sub-minimum orders.

findings.title: Settlement RPC not monitored or reconnected
findings.description: Vault client initialized once. RPC death mid-session disables all settlement operations.
findings.evidence: No reconnection logic. No health check. Failure detected only when operation fails.
findings.recommendation: Wrap vault client in reconnection logic with exponential backoff.

findings.title: Vision dual-balance invariant unchecked
findings.description: realBalance + virtualBalance + fees should equal USDC reserves. No runtime validation.
findings.evidence: No checkBalanceInvariant() function. No Foundry invariant tests.
findings.recommendation: Add invariant check function. Write Foundry invariant tests.
